title: Welcome to Yumunio
intro: Add your name and email address to get started.
settingsIntro: Change this site's appearance and sign-in methods.
setupDisabled: This site is not ready yet. Please contact the person who installed it.
loginRequired: Sign in as an instance administrator to change these settings.
name: Name
registrationHelp: Open registration requires email delivery. Administrators can sign in while registration is closed.
infrastructure: Change appearance and sign-in methods here. Only fill password fields when you want to change them.
completeHelp: Sign in with the account you just created and start writing your first page.
error: Unable to confirm the save. Check your inputs and connection. Reload to see the current state.
conflict: Settings changed or setup has already completed. Reload to see the current state.
SETUP_TOKEN_REJECTED: This initial setup link cannot be used. Open the link shown during installation.
SETUP_INVALID_OWNER: Check the name, email address and 12–128 character password.
SETUP_INVALID_SETTINGS: Check the settings. Email and external login require all relevant fields to be configured.
SETUP_MAIL_REQUIRED: Configure email delivery before opening registration.
SETUP_COMPLETE: Setup has already completed. Reload and sign in.
SETUP_EXISTING_INSTANCE: Setup cannot run on an instance with existing data.
workspaceIntro: Choose a name and appearance. You can change these later.
openInitialLink: Open the ?Start setup? link shown when this site was installed. It will take you to the form for your name and email address.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
workerMailChoice: When Yumunio runs on Cloudflare, configure either Cloudflare Email Service (a send binding) or SMTP (including Cloudflare's SMTP endpoint).
cloudflareIntro: Send directly through Cloudflare without entering a connection password on this screen.
cloudflareDomain: Add your sender domain under Email Service → Email Sending in Cloudflare.
cloudflareBinding: Add an email sending binding to the Yumunio Worker and name it EMAIL.
cloudflareSave: Enter the sender email address, save, and test from server administration.
cloudflareConnected: Cloudflare email sending is connected. Run a test to check sender verification and delivery.
cloudflareNotConnected: Connect email sending in Cloudflare before saving this method.
smtpHelp: Enter the connection details and password supplied by your email service. Changing encryption also switches the standard connection port automatically.
workerSmtpHelp: Connect to an external SMTP service using encryption, usually on port 465 or 587. Workers cannot use port 25 or destinations restricted by Cloudflare. For restricted destinations, choose direct Cloudflare sending or an HTTPS mail relay.
cloudflareSmtpHelp: For Cloudflare SMTP, onboard your domain in Email Sending and enter credentials with sending permission as the password.
mailTestHelp: After saving, you can send a test to your own email address.
SETUP_CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL_REQUIRED: Connect email sending to Yumunio in Cloudflare with the binding name EMAIL. On Docker, choose SMTP or an HTTPS relay.
SETUP_SMTP_PORT: Workers cannot use port 25. Use your provider's encrypted connection, such as port 465 or 587.
